items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I knew Al. ... He used to come in the club. ... The guys, they were very nice to me.

ctx.x: Did you ever see Al Capone?

I knew Al. Hmm? Sure. You did know him? Yeah, all the boys, yeah. Yeah? Did you work with him? Gang, yeah. No, I didn't wake for him. He used to come in the club. Uh-huh. Plantation all the time. The plantation, huh? They used to bring him liquor. Good liquor. The guys, they were very nice to me. Probation time. They used to give me the best liquor to let me drink now.
